mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate indicates accommodative monetary policy, which reduces the cost of capital and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of all periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Consumer Price Index above 260 (annualized) signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which reduces equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 260.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate and high unemployment rate signals an active monetary policy response to economic weakness, which is priced into equity markets as a positive catalyst, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.1 and UNRATE > 6.5.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 6.5%), a decline in the unemployment rate signals improving labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 6.5.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1500 thousand units signals weak consumer demand, which reduces expectations for corporate revenue growth, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1500.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust economic output, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of all periods.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales below 540,000 million dollars signals weak consumer spending, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS < 540000.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strong labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of all periods.
